summary: 80-foot fire tower on Pilot Knob in Catoosa Wildlife Management Area, Morgan County; NHLR-registered 2016; no build date found.

access.note: In a public wildlife management area that closes between sunset and sunrise. Some interior roads are gated and open seasonally. No source says whether the tower itself may be climbed.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No source read gives a build year, staffing history or fire history for this tower. The register is the only source describing the tower itself; the wildlife-area details come from Wikipedia and a hunting guide, which is not an official source. Height 80 ft is converted to 24.4 m; it is the register's overall figure, not a verified cab height. Elevation: register 2,070 ft (631 m); state list 2051 ft (not used). Access level public refers to the wildlife area; no source says whether the tower can be climbed, so visit is omitted. A change.org petition to restore the Catoosa and Cove Creek towers came up in search but was not read; it may hold build history and should be checked before any build date is added. Not verified: current condition.
